scope: All 150 current QiMap profiles and three independent discovery candidates
google_maps_policy: Google Maps URL Searches are user-triggered and do not require API key. A search link is not a coordinate or an independently verified GIS point. Google Place IDs can be persisted, but Google Geocoding/Places lat/lng results have storage and non-Google map restrictions. Do not scrape Google Maps or use Google Maps-derived coordinates on the OSM QiMap base map.
